title: The Real Reason You Clean When You're Stressed
hook: Feeling stressed but suddenly need to clean your whole house?

narration.text: That urge to organise when you are stressed is a coping mechanism.
Your brain is trying to regain a sense of control.
Stress often makes us feel overwhelmed and powerless.
It provides a clear beginning, middle, and end to a task.
This helps to calm your mind and reduce anxiety.
Try it right now and tell us if it worked for you, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more insights into your mind.

description: Ever notice a sudden urge to clean or organise when you're feeling stressed? This video explains the surprising psychological reason behind this common coping mechanism. Understand why tidying up can actually help calm your mind when life feels out of control.
topic: Why you might feel a sudden urge to clean or organise when you are stressed. This is a coping mechanism.
